# WeLinkTalent Careers

> WeLinkTalent is a boutique executive search and recruitment firm based in Singapore, hiring senior and mid-level technology talent since 2015. We are four consultants, not forty: the person you meet is the person who runs your search, from first call to offer. No handoff, no account manager.

## What we do

We place senior and mid-level professionals across AI, machine learning, DevOps, data engineering, cloud, software, fintech, web3, finance, aviation and business development. Typical roles: AI/ML and DevOps engineers, data scientists, platform and cloud engineers, product managers, and C-level or director appointments.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2015
- Location: Singapore, with roles across Asia
- Focus: executive search and recruitment for technology, finance, aviation, AI and data
- Singapore roles are open to Singaporeans, PRs and Employment Pass holders

## Pages

- [Open Job Opportunities](https://welinktalent.github.io/careers/): current open positions, auto-synced daily from careers.welinktalent.com.
- [Where we can support your search](https://welinktalent.github.io/careers/map/): the IESF member network and the 121 countries with employer-of-record coverage.
- [WeLinkTalent website](https://welinktalent.com): executive search and recruitment.
- [Full job board](https://careers.welinktalent.com/): browse and apply to every open mandate.
